h1: Approve it once and stop worrying about it.
title: For schools and districts
sub: For principals, performing arts coordinators and college departments: how we protect student data, and what purchasing needs from us.
cta: Ask for our data privacy agreement.

faq.a: It's priced and set up per program. A district can bring its programs on one at a time or together; talk to us about a district agreement.

faq.q: Can our school pay by purchase order or check?
faq.a: Yes. We'll send a quote, then an invoice due in 30 days, and a W-9 or any vendor form your purchasing office needs. A program can start as soon as the invoice is sent.

faq.q: Will you sign our data privacy agreement?
faq.a: Yes. We sign a data privacy agreement with your district, or review the one your district already uses.
